long_biography.plain_text:
Agrocomplex operates as a full-cycle agricultural and food producer, connecting crops and animal husbandry with processing, logistics and its own retail network. Under Alexander Tkachev's control, the group expanded through land purchases and acquisitions, assembling a broad product range from meat and dairy to oil, flour and sugar.

Tkachev's operating background was technical rather than financial. Trained as a mechanical engineer, he advanced through production roles as a heating engineer and chief mechanic before becoming a director. The reorganised business joined feed production to a wider agricultural base; subsequent acquisitions extended that system across farming and food manufacturing.
